HSSC Announces Additional Shortlist for PMT Exam, Inviting Candidates for 9 Posts Including Forest Guard

The Haryana Staff Selection Commission (HSSC) has announced an additional shortlist for the Prime Minister's Technical Examination (PMT), inviting candidates for 9 posts including Forest Guard. The move is seen as a significant development in the recruitment process, with many sports enthusiasts expressing interest in applying for these positions.
